'''Flame Night''' was a term used to describe an operation undertaken by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] against [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early days of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The operation, conducted at night, was one of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius's]] first; it involved the killing of numerous Force-sensitives in an effort to extinguish future threats to Imperial rule and lure survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] out of hiding and into an ambush. The Inquisitors succeeded in their objectives and received high praise from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for their work.
